Ski and snowboard rental

Ski and snowboard rental 3 minutes from Sinaia train station

A full ski set (skis, boots, poles) or snowboard set (board, boots) for 60 lei a day, the lowest price in Sinaia. Sizes for children and adults, from beginner to advanced. We choose it together, based on height, weight and level, in 5 minutes. The deposit is simple: we take a copy of your ID. We don't keep your document and we don't ask for a cash deposit.

Book your equipmentMessage us on WhatsApp
60 leiper day, full setSee all prices

What else you'll find here

A changing room, luggage storage for the whole day, helmets and goggles at 15 lei a day each, and a taxi we call for you to the gondola (around 30 lei per ride, up to 3 people with equipment). When you rent, you also receive a voucher for 10% off at Ramayana restaurant, 50 metres away.

How it works

  1. Book online the evening before, or just come in between 08:00 and 18:00.
  2. Get changed, leave your bags, try on the boots.
  3. Take the taxi to the gondola. In the evening, return the gear and collect your bags.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to book?
No, but if you do, your equipment is set aside in your size and there's no wait at all.
Can I rent just boots or just skis?
Yes: skis 40 lei/day, boots 40 lei/day, poles 20 lei/day.
Do you have children's equipment?
Yes, from small boot sizes up to adults.
What do I leave as a deposit?
Nothing: we take a copy of your ID and that's it. You keep your document.
Can I leave my own equipment with you?
Yes, in the luggage storage, for the day.
What if the gondola isn't running?
We move your booking at no cost. If you've paid and the gondola didn't run at all that day, we refund you.

Book in the evening, it's ready in the morning.

The form shows your total and sends the request on WhatsApp.
